description:
[read-only] Retention curves of two or more videos, from point ids returned by get_video_explorer (`postId:platform`, comma-separated in `ids`). Each curve comes as share of the video and as seconds, so videos of different lengths overlay; `axis` says which unit fits them all. Videos the network has no curve for are listed in `missing` (not reported, never zero).
(Wraps GET /api/v2/analytics/videos/compare.)
name: compare_videos
title: Overlay video retention curves
